commits.summary: Pin the full historical Java comparison (verification pending)
commits.body:
Bind the original 187 ordered claims to their observations, source graphs and 57 byte-exact program and oracle files. Restore the November 7 conformance fixture in scratch space and retain both strict checker commands, outputs and harnesses on Temurin 25.0.5. Job 20261124-061625-remeasure-all-187-historical-claims-befo measures the two integrated columns at opening.

The manifest verified locally. The changed-file run passed 33 of 34 test groups, including the Rust suite on retry. After updating the benchmark staging test doubles for the optional evidence callback and source override, all 29 benchmark tests passed.

commits.body:

Keep the reproducible seed, identities, screening history and changelog evidence outside the development checkout. Verify the shared executable public APIs, all 32 binary package digests, 16 distinct projects and the manifest commitment.

The affected tests passed. The Rust encoding estimate timing test passed on its automatic retry. The side workspace adopted 14 previously missing repository logs before this check.

commits.summary: Measure independent stock Java assertions (verification pending)
commits.body:
Generate standalone assertions for all 187 pinned programs, including separate old class definitions, bounded nonnull arrays, exceptional returns and mutable frames. Each target has a false control after normal return. Record literal JBMC property reports, costs and traces, and replay reconstructed inputs on the historical JDK. Job 20261124-063606-measure-standalone-stock-jbmc-on-the-exa measures the opening stock column.

Compiled all 374 Java entrypoints and replayed the seven original known witnesses for the real and held-out programs. The repository-selected tests passed.

commits.summary: Reproduce mixed Lucene wire behavior (verification pending)
commits.body:
One thin caller compiled against 8.11.0 wrote and read frames in separate unmodified JVMs. Both local results are 0x01020304, both mixed results are 0x04030201, and both sentinels and cursors held. The two-copy symbolic caller checks round trips, byte-level slice frames and variable integers. Qualify the relocated old graph against both original JVM assertion modes.

The old-only strict probe verified the all-int property. The mixed probe refused MethodHandles.byteArrayViewVarHandle in the Lucene 9 initializer. Job 20261124-064322-measure-mixed-lucene-wire-claims-on-both records all three checker profiles. The affected test groups passed.
